Container.Name: arr-digest
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted digest bot for Sonarr and Radarr. Listens for their webhook notifications, shows additions/upgrades/removals live in a web UI, and posts a scheduled summary to Discord. Configure the digest schedule, Discord webhook, and display options from the web UI after starting the container.
This image is not published to a registry — build it locally on the Unraid host first (see README.md's "Running on Unraid" section), then Unraid will use that local `arr-digest:latest` image instead of trying to pull one. If you skip the build step, container start will fail with "no such image".

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI, and for the webhook URLs you'll paste into Sonarr/Radarr

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (settings, event history)

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone. Note: the digest send time itself is set in the app's Settings page, in whatever timezone you pick there — this only affects container logs/timestamps.
